what: Source temperatures T_s of DESIGN §5.9 step 3 (l_s = max(-6, log_softmax(raw_s / T_s))), shipped as DecoderParams.temp defaults

lv.set: mini-D2 (72 items, 12 idioms x 3 keys x 2 tempos), exact labels
lv.method: class-level NLL over the full vocabulary, cells with >= 75% GT coverage, weighted by cell length in beats (decode/calibrate.fit via eval/calibration.py)
lv.note: after the M2 power-chord fix; before it the fit was 0.657 (NLL 1.356 -> 1.206)

bas.set: mini-D2 cells with an active bass track (weighted by activity)
bas.why_not_the_d2_fit: The synthetic bass (a clean sawtooth through htdemucs) has none of the real tracker's errors. On real audio the NLL-optimal temperature is far softer: 1.26 on the M bars and 1.24 on the H bars of 回家's draft chart (disjoint sets; tracker agrees with the bar-level bass 72%); 0.99 on 回家 and 0.70 on 10,000 Reasons against cells where lv's own bass head is >= 0.9 (biased to easy cells). At T = 0.39 the real-audio NLL more than doubles (2.90 vs 1.22 nats/cell on 回家's H bars). T = 1.0 is the midpoint (geometric mean ~0.95) of the real-audio estimates. Refit on D2 + reviewed D1 songs (M4/M5).

lv_offset_s.note: crossing of the old/new chord lv scores vs the D2 change times; within the +-20 ms acceptance, no correction applied
